summary: Full backend/frontend regression after cookie-auth and component refactors. Backend suites pass 40/40 after correcting two stale unauthenticated-test assumptions and adding Google-only login coverage. Desktop UI passed signup, httpOnly cookie/no-localStorage verification, reload persistence, logout, build create/pay/deploy/share, existing-user login, conversations/history, real AI chat, landing content, and known public sharing. Two regressions remain: the specifically requested /share/genesis-clone-1 URL is not found, and protected Dashboard/Chat layouts horizontally overflow on mobile.

critical.issue: Returns 404, so the required public /share/genesis-clone-1 page renders 'Build not found'. Public sharing itself works for existing slug 49d1ac77 and newly generated slugs.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px viewport, Dashboard document width is 613px and Chat document width is 514px. Header/navigation overflow; Chat sidebar is squeezed/clipped and main content extends off-screen.

integration_issues.issue: Unauthenticated navigation to /share/genesis-clone-1 calls /api/share/genesis-clone-1, receives 404, and shows the not-found state instead of a public build.

issues: Chat has 124px horizontal overflow; sidebar labels and header/user email are clipped and message/input content extends beyond the viewport.

action_items: Restore/seed a deployed build with share_slug='genesis-clone-1', or correct the required canonical public URL if 49d1ac77 is the intended slug.
Make Dashboard header/navigation responsive and implement a mobile Chat sidebar pattern (drawer/collapse), with min-width constraints so both pages avoid horizontal scrolling.
Re-run public-share and 390px responsive browser tests after fixes.
Resolve full frontend lint findings in touched ChatPage/MessageList files (unescaped entities and unused eslint-disable directives).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 727 lines, exceeding the 700-line split threshold; move auth, builds/share, chat, and landing routes into focused routers.
JWT_SECRET has a hardcoded fallback and EMERGENT_SESSION_API is hardcoded; security-sensitive configuration should come from required environment variables and fail fast when absent.
UserCreate/UserLogin/BuildCreate use unconstrained strings; add EmailStr and meaningful min/max length validation for email, password, build name, descriptions, and chat messages.

The cookie migration invalidated two old negative tests because their shared requests.Session now retained the auth cookie. The tests were corrected to use a fresh unauthenticated requests call; this was a test defect, not an authorization bypass.

success_rate.frontend: 92% of executed desktop/mobile checks; all critical desktop auth/build/chat flows passed

seed_data_creation: Created UI account TEST_signup_ui_1785588195403@maligee.ai with one free deployed build and one mock-paid deployed build. Sent one real AI chat turn on the existing credentialed account. Google-only/session fixtures were auto-cleaned; backend regression suite generated unique test users/builds/waitlist records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression is green at 40/40. Auth cookie is httpOnly/secure/SameSite=None, maligee_token stays absent, reload persistence and logout redirect pass. Conversation query-param history and real AI response pass. Known public slug 49d1ac77 works without auth; only required slug genesis-clone-1 is missing. Retest mobile at 390x844 and assert document.scrollWidth <= clientWidth on Dashboard and Chat.
rca_of_the_issue: Share RCA: SharePage correctly requests /api/share/{slug}; server.py only returns a DB build whose share_slug matches and status is deployed. No matching deployed record exists for genesis-clone-1, so the API correctly emits 404 but violates the requested fixture/URL contract. Mobile RCA: Dashboard uses a non-wrapping multi-group header/nav, while Chat uses a fixed desktop flex/sidebar composition with no responsive breakpoint or drawer; wide children force document overflow at 390px.
